Equities.title: Equities: Tech leadership returns as Oil swings – Danske Bank
Equities.summary: Danske Research Team notes that European equities rebounded strongly, with Stoxx 600 up 2% and OMX Nordic nearly 3%, while US indices ended slightly lower. Tech and growth stocks outperformed value despite a modest rise in US 10‑year yields.

Equities.title: S&P 500: Resilient but choppy on oil and credit news – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank analysts note that US equities remain relatively resilient despite sharp intraday swings. The S&P 500 slipped slightly and closed well off its highs, while futures recovered overnight.

Equities.title: Oracle stock jumps 9% on earnings beat and increased guidance as cloud revenue climbs 44%
Equities.summary: Oracle boosted its revenue backlog total by $30 billion during the February quarter.

Rates.title: US CPI set to remain steady in February as markets assess Fed policy outlook
Rates.summary: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will publish the February Consumer Price Index (CPI) data on Wednesday. The report is expected to show a stabilization in inflation, still above the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) 2% target.

Rates.title: USD: Inflation risks keep Fed easing constrained – DBS
Rates.summary: DBS Group Research economist Eugene Leow highlights that consensus expects US CPI at 2.4% year-on-year and 0.3% month-on-month for February, with investors highly sensitive to upside surprises.

FX.title: USD: War-driven oil shock clouds Fed path – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Antje Praefcke argues that US inflation data are unlikely to move the Dollar near term, as markets focus on Oil and the Iran war.

FX.title: Japanese Yen struggles as BoJ policy outlook remains uncertain
FX.summary: USD/JPY gains ground for the second successive session, trading around 158.30 during the European hours on Wednesday. The pair appreciates as the Japanese Yen (JPY) struggles due to uncertainty surrounding the Bank of Japan (BoJ) policy outlook.
